fields.statement: Plan review round 3 left finding f1 (contradiction on ship-change-prepush-fix): The plan only changes the built-in workflows (internal/workflow/builtin/ship-change.toml, plan.toml, plan-milestone.toml) and its acceptance checks only those, but accepted in-flight change set 01M763YX (milestone-32, which the intent says to coordinate with) gives Rhiza's own repo its own workflows in .rhiza/workflows (rhiza-own-workflows-go-cleanup: workflows that set GOTMPDIR; ship-head-build-step: 'Rhiza's own ship-change workflow builds rhiza from the PR head in a step'). If those repo workflows replace ship-change (and plan/plan-milestone) rather than include the built-ins, the new on.fail -> ship gate --failed triage -> gate-fix / prepush-fix routing never reaches this repo's runs, the very runs whose CI failures motivated the change. The decision pre-push-check-shape coordinates with milestone-32 only on the setting's name; it should say how the routing reaches repo-level workflow copies (or that 01M763YX's workflows include the built-ins), and plan-prepush-fix has the same gap. rhiza overlaps lists nothing because the two change sets write different nodes. The critic confirmed it: Accepted in-flight 01M763YX (ship-head-build-step: 'Rhiza's own ship-change workflow builds rhiza from the PR head in a step'; rhiza-own-workflows-go-cleanup: Rhiza's own workflows in .rhiza/workflows set GOTMPDIR) gives this repo its own ship-change.toml. By workflow-overrides a repo .rhiza/workflows/ship-change.toml shadows the built-in for every bare-name use, including bugfix's workflow step, and it cannot include the built-in ship-change: the resolver has no builtin: prefix and a repo file naming ship-change resolves to itself, which include.go rejects as a self-include. So that file is a full copy, and the plan's on.fail -> ship gate --failed triage -> gate-fix routing (ship-change-prepush-fix, whose acceptance checks only internal/workflow/builtin) never reaches Rhiza's own runs; the same holds for plan-prepush-fix if 01M763YX copies plan/plan-milestone to set GOTMPDIR. The pre-push check itself sits in shipPush and still runs, but a failure would end the run instead of going to the fixer. Decision pre-push-check-shape coordinates with milestone-32 only on the setting's name, and rhiza overlaps misses this because the two change sets write different nodes. How should it be settled?
